lines.japanese: リンゴーン、リンゴーン……
lines.english: Ding-dong... ding-dong...

lines.japanese: 鐘の音が聞こえる。
lines.english: I heard bells.

lines.japanese: 召集の鐘。
lines.english: The bells that summoned us.

lines.japanese: 俺と鷲介のあいだの、約束の鐘。
lines.english: The bells of the promise between Shusuke and me.

lines.japanese: 俺は立っていたのか横たわっていたのかも分からなかった。しかしそこには扉があったので、ゆっくり押しこんで開けてみた。
lines.english: I couldn't tell whether I was standing or lying down. But there was a door, so I slowly pushed it open.

lines.japanese: 「やほろーん」
lines.english: “Yahallooo.”

lines.japanese: そこには予想通りへらへら鷲介。熊手状の中途半端なパーを顔の横で振っていた。
lines.english: There stood Shusuke, grinning just as expected, waving beside his face with a half-open hand, the fingers crooked like a rake.

lines.japanese: どうにも嘘くさい、貼りつけたような笑顔。
lines.english: A pasted-on smile, false through and through.

lines.japanese: それはいつものことなんだけど、今日このときばかりは、本当に虚勢としか思えないような寂しい笑顔だった。
lines.english: Nothing unusual there. Yet today, of all days, the smile was so lonely it could only have been bravado.

lines.japanese: やつの用件はおおむね分かる。
lines.english: I more or less knew why he had called me.

lines.japanese: たぶん書き置きでも遺して行くだろうとは思ってたけど、直接呼びつけてくるとは思わなかった。
lines.english: I'd expected him to leave a note behind before he went. I hadn't expected him to summon me in person.

lines.japanese: だって千歳鷲介は誰よりもヘコみ屋のくせして、誰よりもヘコんでる顔を隠したがるやつだから。
lines.english: Because Shusuke Chitose got down harder than anyone, yet hated letting anyone see him down more than anyone.

lines.japanese: 「なんだよ。おまえ最近、調子よろしくないみたいじゃん」
lines.english: “What’s up? You haven’t seemed yourself lately.”

lines.japanese: やつの流儀にのっとって、俺は深刻な内容を軽薄な冗談でコーティングした。
lines.english: I followed his lead and coated something serious in a cheap joke.

lines.japanese: 「あ、やっぱり分かる？」
lines.english: “Oh. You could tell?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、なんとなくだけど。なに、職場イジメにでも遭ってんの」
lines.english: “Just a feeling. What, are they bullying you at work?”

lines.japanese: 「まさか。知ってるでしょ、俺の性格。そんなんだったら、俺とっくに逃げてるよ」
lines.english: “Hardly. You know me. If that were happening, I'd have run ages ago.”

lines.japanese: にっ。鷲介にしてはヘタクソな笑顔を作った。俺はそういうツラなら嫌いじゃなかった。
lines.english: A grin. Clumsy by Shusuke's standards. I didn't dislike that face on him.

lines.japanese: 「いやあ、実はさあ。俺、最近死神が見えるようになってきちゃって。牧師さんとの≪約束の日≫も近いからね、そろそろ頃合いかなーって思ってんだ」
lines.english: “Well, actually... I’ve started seeing the Grim Reaper lately. And the *Promised Day* with the pastor’s coming up, so I was thinking it might be about time.”
“Yeah...”

lines.japanese: タカシの卒業を迎えたら、俺たちは統合を目指すという約束。
lines.english: We had agreed to seek integration once Takashi reached graduation.

lines.japanese: ひとりの全き存在へ戻るために。
lines.english: To become one whole being again.

lines.japanese: 「まあ自分自身で決着はつけたし？　も、ここらで一発パーッとやって、それを泡沫の夢にサヨナラしとこうかなって。あとのことは隼人君にお任せしたいのよ」
lines.english: “Well, I’ve settled it for myself, right? So I thought I’d have one last blowout, then say goodbye to this fleeting dream. I’d like to leave whatever comes next to you, Hayato.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、タカシ君だけど、カレ最近なにかと≪スクランブル≫が多くて。彼も留まる意思は薄そうだね」
lines.english: “Oh, and there've been an awful lot of *Scrambles* around Takashi lately. He doesn't seem especially eager to remain either.”
“...Right.”

lines.japanese: 「まったく、お兄ちゃんを思う弟心を分かってないよねえ。でもそれが本当に彼の望みだっていうなら、受けいれてあげれば？」
lines.english: “Honestly. He doesn't understand a little brother's devotion to his big brother. But if that truly is what he wants, why not grant him his wish?”

lines.japanese: 「おまえはそれでいいわけ」
lines.english: “And you're really fine with that?”

lines.japanese: 「いいからこういう話をしてるの。あとのことは隼人君とお医者さまに任せるよ」
lines.english: “I wouldn't be saying this if I weren't. I'll leave the rest to you and the doctor.”

lines.japanese: 「で、俺からのお願い。おりしも今日は土曜日。だからさ、そっちの都合もあるだろうけど、もし可能なら今日が最後だと思って１２時……いや１１時まででいいや。遊ばせてくれないかなあ」
lines.english: “So, my request. As fate would have it, today's Saturday. I know you've got plans of your own, but if you can, let me treat it as my last day and play until midnight... No. Eleven will do.”

lines.japanese: 俺は後頭部に手を伸ばして盛大にぐしゃぐしゃ掻きむしった。
lines.english: I reached behind my head and raked violently through my hair.

lines.japanese: 終わりが見えてる以上、引きとめることに意味はない。どうにも歯がゆいもんだ。
lines.english: With the end already in sight, there was no point asking him to stay. God, it was frustrating.

lines.japanese: もし鷲介が恋やら仕事やらに情熱を捧げていれば、また違った決断もあったのだろうか。俺がそうだったように。
lines.english: If Shusuke had poured his passion into love or work, might he have chosen differently? Just as I had.

lines.japanese: 「まァ、いいよ。今日は俺の時間ぜんぶやる」
lines.english: “Fine. Today is yours. All of it.”
“What?”

lines.japanese: 「あした日曜だろ。好きなだけハジケてこいよ」
lines.english: “Tomorrow's Sunday. Go cut loose as long as you like.”

lines.japanese: 鷲介はふっと息をはいて前髪を揺らした。いつものカッコつけ癖。でもここでカッコつけられるやつは本当にカッコいいやつだと思った。
lines.english: Shusuke breathed out, stirring his bangs. That old habit of trying to look cool. But anyone who could manage it at a moment like this really was cool.

lines.japanese: 「あらら、最後の最後でそんな、鷲介兄ちゃんにまで可愛い弟心を発揮？　やめてよ、泣いちゃうじゃない」
lines.english: “Oh my. At the very, very end, you're showing sweet little-brother devotion even to your dear old Shusuke? Stop. You'll make me cry.”

lines.japanese: 「うるせえ、俺は表現方法がちょっぴりキツ目なだけで、元来かわいい弟なんだよブッ殺すぞコノヤロウ」
lines.english: “Shut up. I’m a sweet little brother at heart. I’ve just got a rough way of showing it. I’ll fucking kill you, asshole.”

lines.japanese: 「あはは、さんくー。したらいっちょパーッと盛りあがってくるかな。そんじゃね隼人君、また来世～」
lines.english: “Ha ha. Thanks. Guess I'll go paint the town red. See you, Hayato. Next life!”

lines.japanese: ≪面談≫の時間は終わり、別離のときが来た。
lines.english: The *Interview* was over. It was time to part.

lines.japanese: 「鷲介」
lines.english: “Shusuke.”

lines.japanese: 互いに意識が薄れゆく中、俺はやつの名を呼んだ。
lines.english: As consciousness faded from us both, I called his name.

lines.japanese: 「なあ、思わねえか？　俺たちもし違う形で生まれてたら、案外いいツレになってたんじゃねーかな」
lines.english: “Hey. Don't you think that if we'd been born some other way, we might've made pretty good friends?”

lines.japanese: 「ええ？　なに今更。俺まともに口喧嘩できるやつなんて、隼人君の他にいなかったもん。最期だから言っとくけど、君は生涯ただひとりの親友だったよ」
lines.english: “What? You’re only asking now? I never had anyone else I could really argue with. Since this is the end, I’ll tell you: you’ve been my one and only best friend.”

lines.japanese: 「だったら決まりだ。おまえは消えるんじゃない、俺のツレになるんだ」
lines.english: “Then it’s settled. You’re not disappearing. You’re coming with me, as my friend.”

lines.japanese: 「はは！　素晴らしい、それはいい考えだ。それじゃあ今後とも、ぬるっとよろしく」
lines.english: “Ha! Wonderful. Excellent idea. Then here's to a long and slippery friendship.”

lines.japanese: 「おう。行ってこい」
lines.english: “Yeah. Go on.”

lines.japanese: 急かすように鐘の音がわんわん震え、たちこめる白い靄が無情にも俺たちを分かつ。
lines.english: The bells quaked and clamored as if hurrying him, while the gathering white mist divided us without mercy.

lines.japanese: 俺は鷲介の姿を最後まで見届けなかった。
lines.english: I looked away before he was gone.

lines.japanese: だって、べつに感傷的になるようなトコじゃない。やつは消えてなくなるわけじゃなくて、この先ずっと俺の中で生きてゆくんだ。
lines.english: Because this wasn't a place for sentiment. He wasn't going to vanish. From this day on, he would live inside me forever.

lines.japanese: そうだよな、兄貴。
lines.english: Right, brother?

lines.japanese: いや、マイベストフレンド。
lines.english: No—my best friend.

lines.japanese: 「なんつって」
lines.english: “Or something.”

lines.japanese: 俺は細く息を吹きあげて前髪を揺らした。
lines.english: I blew a thin breath upward, stirring my bangs.
